title: Chapter Lead Data Scientist - Financial Crime @ING Hubs Romania
full_description:
Discover ING Hubs Romania
ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟎𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐡-𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐬,𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐤,𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐟𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐬.
We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦𝐭𝐰𝐨𝐥𝐨𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬:𝐁𝐮𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐂𝐥𝐮𝐣-𝐍𝐚𝐩𝐨𝐜𝐚.
𝐎𝐮𝐫𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐜𝐚𝐩𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐜𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐨𝐟𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐛𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products.
We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.
For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?
ING’s goal is to enable people to “do their thing” and empower them to stay a step ahead in life and in business. We are one of the largest banks in Europe and we continuously evolve to become one of the most innovative companies in the banking sector.
The ING Analytics group is a major driving force in ING’s transformation, aimed at helping us to become a data-driven digital leader and creating tangible value for ING and its customers through world-class analytics products and services.
In our ING Analytics for COO Analytics Tribe, we are passionate about creating advanced analytics applications to mitigate the risk of financial economic crimes (FEC) for our society, and about delivering models and products across multiple countries and domains, making ING a safer and more compliant bank. This is a diverse international group which combines data, IT, and product management roles in interdisciplinary squads, and we strive to push the boundaries of utilizing our big and sensitive data sources with statistical and machine learning understanding to tackle important challenges, such as anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorist financing (CTF), post-transaction monitoring (PTM), customer due diligence (CDD) or transactional fraud.
As we continue our growth and establishing the added value analytics bring to our domain, we seek a team/chapter leadership profile which can lead a small (5-8) group of data scientists. As a data science chapter lead, your role will have four (4) main aspects:
As a member of product delivery team, you will act as a senior data scientist as part of a model/product building squad. You will work on a financial crime use case, applying statistical, data science and machine learning approaches, and support the product owner in driving the delivery of the analytics product.
As a member of product delivery team, you will act as a senior data scientist as part of a model/product building squad. You will work on a financial crime use case, applying statistical, data science and machine learning approaches, and support the product owner in driving the delivery of the analytics product.
As the lead of your chapter, you are the direct manager of the data scientists in your chapter. You will drive the skills and career development of your chapter members, set targets, and evaluate their performance in squads, providing feedback and guiding them technically and professionally.
As the lead of your chapter, you are the direct manager of the data scientists in your chapter. You will drive the skills and career development of your chapter members, set targets, and evaluate their performance in squads, providing feedback and guiding them technically and professionally.
As a part of the tribe’s management team, you are responsible for the success of the tribe with various activities, recruitment, ranging from setting standards for model development, staffing squads with talent from the tribe, setting up non-financial risk (NFR) controls, reviewing squad progress and providing feedback.
As a part of the tribe’s management team, you are responsible for the success of the tribe with various activities, recruitment, ranging from setting standards for model development, staffing squads with talent from the tribe, setting up non-financial risk (NFR) controls, reviewing squad progress and providing feedback.
As a leader in the wider ING Analytics community, you will be a part of a wider group of chapter leads who drive the development of ING Analytics for all its members and take on activities such as forming and building professional guilds and meet-ups, specifying requirements for platform teams, optimizing processes for obtaining data and model validation, and engaging with senior stakeholders to realize the transformation of ING with advanced analytics.
As a leader in the wider ING Analytics community, you will be a part of a wider group of chapter leads who drive the development of ING Analytics for all its members and take on activities such as forming and building professional guilds and meet-ups, specifying requirements for platform teams, optimizing processes for obtaining data and model validation, and engaging with senior stakeholders to realize the transformation of ING with advanced analytics.
What you bring to the team:
At ING, we promote diversity not just because it is the right thing to do, but because it is essential for delivering on our strategy. To stay a step ahead we need teams with a healthy mix of contrasting perspectives and backgrounds as they are more creative, faster to adapt to and more inventive with their solutions. We strive to hire a workforce as diverse as the communities in which we operate, and we will consider every application, regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, or age.
If you are an experienced senior data scientist / machine learning developer (5+ years), or you are currently leading a data science team (1+ years) and are looking to lead a talented group tackling one of the most meaningful and important domains in FinTech today, we would love to hear from.
Additional optional criteria which will be considered separately as a “plus”:
Prior experience in either the KYC, anti-money laundering (AML) or Anti-Fraud domains.
Prior experience in either the KYC, anti-money laundering (AML) or Anti-Fraud domains.
Strong python development skills and python-specific best practices knowledge.
Strong python development skills and python-specific best practices knowledge.
Specific experience in the fields of either: outlier detection, representation learning or graph analytics.
Specific experience in the fields of either: outlier detection, representation learning or graph analytics.
Proven leadership experience.
Proven leadership experience.
